Andrew Johnson; in 1920, Adolf Hitler made his first official speech as head

movement. Nazis, pedophiles, impeachment … no relevance to today whatsoever. _

wish you a lovely day, wherever you are, and wherever you're going. There's no
paywall on today's edition of this newsletter, thanks to our friends at
Incogni. Cheers!

watch the speech live with **Mehdi**. And then join our incisive **Swin

Epstein,** but only **OUTSIDE** of the United States; an ICE instructor

describing the law out loud, and Americans have really **soured** on our

# Justice Served… But Elsewhere

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!-8ME!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-

In a growing number of countries, there seems to be severe consequences, or at
least genuine scrutiny, for associating with Jeffrey Epstein.

But not in the United States.

Over in the United Kingdom, for example, British police just arrested [Peter
Mandelson](https://zeteo.com/p/peter-mandelson-epstein-secrets-leak-brown-uk),
the veteran Labour politician and former ambassador to the United States, for
suspicion of misconduct in public office, related to allegedly passing
confidential information to Epstein. They've also arrested former Prince
Andrew on suspicion of misconduct in office related to Epstein.

In Norway, diplomat Mona Juul was placed on administrative leave, and her
security clearance was revoked after her associations with Epstein were
revealed. She has been charged on suspicion of aggravated corruption. Former
Prime Minister Thorbjørn Jagland has been
[charged](https://www.cnn.com/2026/02/13/europe/norway-pm-jagland-charged-
epstein-ties-intl-hnk) with aggravated corruption as well, due to his ties to
Epstein.

In Slovakia, national security adviser Miroslav Lajčak
[resigned](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cnvgljj1dygo) after the released
files showed him discussing women and diplomacy with Epstein.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

In France, investigators have opened [wide-ranging
investigations](https://www.reuters.com/world/france-opens-epstein-probes-
into-human-trafficking-tax-fraud-2026-02-18/) into human trafficking and
financial fraud; one probe has already seen the former culture minister Jack
Lang [resign](https://apnews.com/article/jeffrey-epstein-files-france-jack-
lang-aab2edd95993de4816c48c4f6fc0c479) from the presidency of the Arab World
Institute.

In Dubai, Sultan Ahmed bin Sulayem, the chief of global logistics empire DP
World, and the chairman of the Ports, Customs & Free Zone Corporation,
resigned from his prominent positions.

And the investigations and inquiries continue around the world.

Yet, here in the US, where there is no shortage of Epstein associates -
including in the [current government](https://zeteo.com/p/trumpworld-epstein-
files) - there _is_ a glaring shortage of any accountability.

The Trump-Vance administration has spent months delaying the release of,
muddying the waters around, and covering up the Epstein files. It has smeared
victims and aggressively pounced on the few Republican Party elected officials
who have supported transparency. And perhaps it is all unsurprising,
considering the party is helmed by a man who is mentioned in the files [more
than almost anyone else](https://zeteo.com/p/epstein-26000-emails-read-search-
trump-summers-thiel), and who was a longtime pal to the world's most infamous
pedophile.

Notably, in the absence of any kind of legal pathway to actual accountability,
it is only social pressure that has led to the mildest of consequences for a
handful of Epstein-related individuals. We've seen a few resignations, but no
real investigations.

Brian Karp, chairman of the law firm Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison,
_[resigned](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/02/05/business/dealbook/karp-paul-
weiss-epstein.html)_. Former counsel for President Barack Obama, Kathryn
Ruemmler - a figure whose name was all over the Epstein files -
_[resigned](https://www.cnn.com/2026/02/12/politics/kathy-ruemmler-resigns-
goldman-sachs-epstein-fallout)_ from her chief legal role at Goldman Sachs.
Thomas Pritzker
_[resigned](https://chicago.suntimes.com/news/2026/02/16/thomas-pritzker-
resigns-hyatt-hotels-jeffrey-epstein-emails)_ as executive chairman of Hyatt
Hotels Corporation. Wellness influencer Peter Attia
_[resigned](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/dr-peter-attia-exits-cbs-news-
contributor-paramount-warner-1236670513/)_ from Bari Weiss's CBS News.

It's jarring. Instead of justice, we get the Attorney General Pam Bondi
[screaming erratically ](https://www.instagram.com/reels/DUo5OgNjOeG/)at
Congress and spying on them as they look through the Epstein files. We get the
FBI director [pounding a tall boy](https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/kash-
patel-fbi-celebrates-mens-hockey-team-winter-olympics-milan-video-rcna260215)
in a locker room thousands of miles away.

Rep. Ro Khanna, who has led the charge to release the files, told **Zeteo**
that it's all **" a moral stain"** on the nation. **" While [the] UK, France,
Norway are prosecuting the Epstein class, Pam Bondi and Kash Patel are missing
in action with no investigations or prosecutions,"** he said.

[Share](https://zeteo.com/p/getting-away-with-epstein-first-
draft?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share)

Members of that Epstein class are walking breezily among us. It cannot be said
often enough: the president of the United States was good friends with Jeffrey
Epstein for many years. There are all sorts of shocking, though unproven,
allegations against Trump in the Epstein files (which he denies).

Then there's the [disturbing note](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/see-
the-alleged-trump-birthday-note-to-epstein-released-by-house-democrats) Trump
allegedly wrote to Epstein for his birthday in 2003, in which he wrote of **"
certain things"** they had in common - written on the frame of a sketch of a
woman's body. **" Enigmas never age,"** the note (written in the form of a
script between the two) read, adding the toast: **" may every day be another
wonderful secret." **(Trump denies writing it.)

There's also what Trump [said](https://www.theguardian.com/us-
news/2025/jul/18/trump-epstein-friendship) just months before that: **" I've
known Jeff for 15 years. Terrific guy… He's a lot of fun to be with. It is
even said that he likes beautiful women as much as I do, and many of them are
on the younger side."**

There's the [April 2011 email](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/read-
jeffrey-epsteins-newly-released-emails-about-trump) from Epstein to Ghislaine
Maxwell in which the late pedophile says: **" I want you to realize that that
dog that hasn't barked is trump."**

In nations across the world, prominent figures tied to Epstein are being
publicly shamed and criminally investigated.

In the US, they're in charge.

## **🗞 ️ **What You Need to Know

  * **GTFO:** GOP Rep. Tony Gonzales is facing [calls](https://x.com/matt____rice/status/2026032681113342315?s=46) to resign from members of his own party - including from Reps. Lauren Boebert, Anna Paulina Luna, and Nancy Mace - following the [release](https://www.24sight.news/p/texts-from-late-staffers-phone-show) of text records showing Gonzales sent sexual messages to a staffer, who later died by suicide. Speaker Mike Johnson called on Gonzales to [address](https://www.cnn.com/2026/02/23/politics/tony-gonzales-affair-allegations-mike-johnson) the allegations, but did not weigh in on whether he should quit.

  * **ICE whistleblower speaks:** A former ICE instructor blew the whistle on the agency's scheme to allow agents to break into people's homes without judicial warrants, in violation of the Fourth Amendment. He [told Congress](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ice-whistleblower-new-recruits-receiving-defective-training/) on Monday that the agency's training for recruits is "deficient" and that "ICE is teaching cadets to violate the Constitution and attempting to cloak it in secrecy by [demanding I lie](https://www.washingtonpost.com/immigration/2026/02/23/former-ice-instructor-says-agency-slashed-training-new-officers/) about it."

  * **Trump better have my money:** Following the Supreme Court's rejection of Trump's tariffs, Senate Democrats are now [demanding](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/feb/23/senate-democrats-tariffs-refund-bill) the president refund the over $175 billion in tariff revenue to US families and businesses. They join Governors [JB Pritzker](https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/5748630-pritzker-demands-trump-tariff-refunds/) and [Gavin Newsom](https://abc7.com/post/gov-gavin-newsom-demands-refund-checks-americans-supreme-court-strikes-down-trumps-tariffs/18627097/), demanding immediate refund checks for Americans. FedEx [wants](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/02/23/fedex-trump-trade-tariffs-refunds-supreme-court-lawsuit.html) its money back, too.

  * **Iran latest:** Axios [reported](https://www.axios.com/2026/02/23/iran-strike-trump-gen-dan-caine-vance-rubio) Monday that Joint Chiefs chairman Gen. Daniel Caine has expressed doubts to Trump about launching another attack on Iran, warning about the risk of US casualties. Trump [disputed](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/116121997925438698) the report, claiming that Caine is on board: "He has not spoken of not doing Iran, or even the fake limited strikes that I had been reading about."

  * **Pirro backs off** : Former Fox host and Trump US Attorney Jeanine Pirro [dropped](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/jeanine-pirros-office-shelves-pursuit-democrats-social-video-sources-s-rcna259783) her failed case against the six Democratic lawmakers who taped a video urging service members to refuse illegal orders. The decision comes two weeks after a grand jury unanimously rejected her office's attempt to secure an indictment in the case.

## 🌏 Anywhere But America

  * **🇵 🇸 Don't forget Gaza: **Heavy rainfall over the last 24 hours has flooded tents housing forcibly displaced Palestinians, [local media reported](https://english.wafa.ps/Pages/Details/167696), making worse the already dire humanitarian crisis in the enclave, as Israel continues to severely restrict aid. 

  * **🇮 🇷 Eyes on Iran:** Students held anti-government [protests](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/feb/23/death-to-dictator-iranian-students-protests-third-day) at universities across Tehran for the third consecutive day on Monday. These protests come ahead of Thursday's nuclear deal discussions in Geneva between US and Iranian negotiators. 

  * **🇺 🇦🇷🇺 Ukraine war anniversary:** Today marks four years since Russia illegally invaded Ukraine in 2022. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky is hosting foreign dignitaries in Kyiv for ceremonies, but Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov [said](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/ukraine-russia-war-putin-zelensky-4-years-ww3-live-news-b2926383.html) the "special military operation" - Moscow's Orwellian term for its invasion - is ongoing and has not yet achieved its aims.

  * 🇲🇽 **Deadly operation:** More than [70](https://apnews.com/article/mexico-jalisco-cartel-mencho-sheinbaum-trump-226e50edc33f981d5d6509acc7021ae5) people, including security officers, cartel members, and others, died in Mexico's military operation that killed Jalisco cartel leader "El Mencho" and the violence that unfolded after, according to authorities.
